claim.summary: A supplied strict real-part gap witness builds the checklist-native PositiveGapEnvelope, and raw residual plus gap witnesses feed the reusable core API to build a checklist and prove shifted dominance.
claim.gap_witness_input: forall p in coords, p.1 <= a - δ
claim.built_checklist: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
claim.dominance_result: forall p in coords, shiftedSqMod c p.1 p.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: strict real-part gap witness builds PositiveGapEnvelope a δ coords
raw residual and strict-gap witnesses build CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
raw residual and strict-gap witnesses imply shifted dominance through the reusable core API
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
